name: Avatar Maker
description: Build your cartoon avatar: skin, hair and colour, eyes, mouth, glasses, hats and background, or roll the dice. Save it as a picture.
prompt: A cartoon avatar maker with skin tones, hairstyles and hair colours, eyes, mouths, glasses, hats, earrings and backgrounds, a random button, saved avatars and export as a PNG.
author: gonzaroman

description_i18n.es: Crea tu avatar de dibujos: piel, pelo y color, ojos, boca, gafas, gorros y fondo, o tira el dado. Guárdalo como imagen.
